# splatmaker-mcp

Self-hosted, zero-marginal-cost Gaussian-splat generation. FOSS alternative to worldlabs-mcp's Marble API - point at a video or images, get a navigable 3D Gaussian-splat world, runs entirely on local GPU.

Status: v0.2.0, Nerfstudio/Splatfacto engine implemented. Server shell, tools, job tracking (SQLite), fleet health/registration contract, webapp skeleton, and the real subprocess pipeline are working. No full end-to-end training run against real capture data yet (needs Sandra's own photos/video).

Full reference: llms-full.txt

## Tools

- splat_generate(operation, video_path?, image_paths?, job_id?) - generate or inspect splat jobs. operation in [from_video, from_images, status, list, get_asset]. All returns carry success + message.
- splat_engine_status() - reports which FOSS engine (if any) is configured
- server_shutdown() - graceful shutdown (matches POST /api/shutdown)

## REST (backend :11091)

- GET /api/health, GET /api/status, GET /api/capabilities, GET /api/jobs, POST /api/jobs/status, POST /api/shutdown
- Webapp on :11092 proxies /api + /mcp same-origin; absolute backend URL only inside Tauri.

## Tools

- splat_generate(operation, video_path?, image_paths?, job_id?) - generate or inspect splat jobs. operation in [from_video, from_images, status, list, get_asset]
- splat_engine_status() - reports which FOSS engine (if any) is configured

## Notable

Downstream consumers must run the raw splat through blender-mcp's blender_splatting tool to get a usable collision mesh - this server does not produce one (unlike worldlabs-mcp, which does). See README.md for details.

## Ports

Backend (MCP + REST): 11091. Frontend (dashboard, not yet built): 11092.
